blocks.text: Real-world analogue: Salt flats, pale volcanic ash, pumice deserts, hoarfrost, wind-carved snow, and white mineral basins that appear similar from a distance while behaving very differently underfoot.
World relation: Quiet World slowness and Crafted World maintenance. The local name belongs to current inhabitants even when it is historically imprecise.
Connection to newer locations: It relates to the Salt Mirror Archive, Ice Cave of Paused Dawn, Tundra Bloom Circuit, Marble Dune Cemetery, and Glacial Memory Fjord.

Abstract or metaphorical relation: A changed word can still hold a truthful present relationship. Recovery of the older technical term should deepen understanding without invalidating what later communities learned to call home.
